title: The Dollar Bill and the Great Seal of 1782
hero_object: 1782 Great Seal of the United States Original Copper Engraving Plate
hook: You found a triangle on a dollar. You haven’t found an owner.
punchline: Drawing a connection isn’t proving one.
visual_paradigm: Currency Engraving Bureau & Numismatic Macro (Bureau Mint Green #064E3B, Antique Parchment #FEF3C7, Ink Black #0F172A)

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: You found a triangle on a dollar. You haven’t found an owner.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Look closely at the back of a one-dollar bill. The pyramid, the Eye of Providence. For decades, posts have claimed these are secret codes proving hidden Jewish control.
scenes.on_screen: THE CLAIM: SECRET BANKING CABAL CODES

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Here is where the art actually comes from. The Continental Congress commissioned the Great Seal in seventeen-seventy-six, and officially adopted it in seventeen-eighty-two.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: The design committee included Benjamin Franklin, Thomas Jefferson, and Charles Thomson. Thomson’s official report explains the pyramid stands for strength and duration. The eye represents providence.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: It wasn’t even added to the paper dollar until nineteen-thirty-five under Franklin Roosevelt. Anyone can doodle lines connecting arbitrary stars to draw a hexagram.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Superimposing geometric lines over eighteenth-century civic art doesn’t reveal a conspiracy. It reveals active imagination.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Drawing a connection isn’t proving one.
scenes.on_screen: DRAWING A CONNECTION ISN'T PROVING ONE
scenes.source: Beyond the Myth · Facts, not scapegoats
